# Performore

> Performore is a founder-led fractional growth team for startups and scale-ups. It connects senior growth strategy with hands-on paid media, creative strategy, analytics, measurement and experimentation.

## Founder

- Mor Sofer is the founder of Performore and a growth marketer based in London, United Kingdom.
- Profile: https://uk.linkedin.com/in/morsofer

## Core services

- [Growth Strategy](https://performore.co/growth-strategy): Full-funnel audits, unit economics, channel architecture and 90-day growth plans.
- [Algorithm Training](https://performore.co/algorithm-training): Server-side tracking, event quality and value signals for advertising platforms.
- [Creative Strategy](https://performore.co/creative-strategy): Angle-first creative systems, hooks, formats and iterative testing.
- [Media Buying](https://performore.co/media-buying): Evidence-led paid media management across Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn and Microsoft.
- [SEO & GEO](https://performore.co/seo-geo): Technical SEO, on-page optimisation, content structure and generative engine optimisation, in four tiers from a one-off audit to full programme ownership.
